title: Hearing Aid Battery Cycle Feed Freshness Gap
dataSources: Mobility-aid status (`mobilityaid:status`), wheelchair battery telemetry (`wheelchair:battery`), stairlift service records (`stairlift:service`), hearing-aid battery records (`hearingaid:battery`), pendant-alert tests (`pendant:test`).
app: Wheelchair battery telemetry, stairlift service records, hearing-aid battery reminders, and pendant-alert test logs streamed to Splunk HEC via apps, service portals, and caregiver forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=hearingaid:battery
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by aid_id
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>72
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects accessibility-device feeds that have stopped reporting inside the expected window.
value: A silent telemetry gap on support gear can hide low battery or missed service, so freshness should alert early.
implementation: Set freshness thresholds according to how often each device normally checks in.
visualization: Table of devices by hours since last update.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates when a hearing aid battery cycle feed has gone quiet and may need checking.
